title: 第620章 一剑杀了第619章 意思可以杀人
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“呃？”
听到林晨的话语，蒋深手握长剑，先是一愣，旋即脸上露出古怪的笑容：“只要你现在跪下来求饶，我当然可以不杀你。”
他实在没想到，城主府居然病急乱投医，请了个元婴境三重巅峰来参加比武大会，简直是自取其辱。
“哈哈哈！这个小子是从哪里冒出来的，他代表城主府参加比武大会？”
“我看城主府真是没办法的办法，居然选个元婴境三重巅峰。”
“他该不会被蒋深当场吓得跪下吧？”
“那样的话，城主府可就真的颜面扫地了。”
不少围观的人，听到林晨的话语，双眼圆睁，眉宇间都是诧异之色，他们想不明白林晨这么问的意义是什么。
“冯大人，这小子真是代表我们城主府参加比武大会？”
几个城主府的成员，也是有些错愕，忍不住歪过头看向冯德坤。
“我……”
冯德坤从昨天晚上就对林晨很不安逸，现在见到林晨站在演武广场之上，众目睽睽之下，居然问出这么低级的问题。
若不是想着现在是比武大会，他真的想要冲上去，让林晨赶紧丢下来，别站在演武广场丢人现眼了。
“任大人，这小子是什么来历？”
刚才从城主府修炼室跟着出来的几人，也满脸诧异。
“唉！一言难尽。”
任奕盯着林晨的背影，忍不住摇摇头，一声叹息。
“不知道怎么回事，这个小子我总感觉他不简单。”几人议论之时，修炼室最先出来的老者开口道：“你们仔细想想，就昨天晚上吸收的天地灵力，就算是你我是高阶造化境巅峰，也做不到吧？”
“好像……”
几人闻言，也是若有所思，微微点头。

“意思只要不跪下来求饶，就可以杀无赦了。”
原本平静的林晨，猛然抬起头来，双眸之中突然爆发出冰冷刺骨的寒意，血夜剑突然出现在手中。
冷厉的剑芒从长剑之上爆发而出，身上的灵力疯狂涌动而起。
整个人身上杀之意境爆发出来，血红色光芒环绕在剑身之上，就见到他一步踏出，长剑朝着蒋深斩出。
“哈哈哈……你也想要……杀我……”
蒋深万万没想到，自己顿住脚步，没有先出手，想不到对方区区元婴境三重巅峰，也敢主动袭击自己。
尤其是，对方也是用剑之人，他可是巨峭城第一剑法天才，眼看着林晨长剑平平无奇的袭来，满脸不屑。
“地级下品剑法：影月剑法。”
蒋深手握长剑，眼看着林晨袭来，身上元婴境七重巅峰的修为爆发出来，显得不慌不忙，眼看着林晨的长剑，刺到距离身前三四米之时，浑身灵力才疯狂涌动，长剑举起来，满脸冷厉地道：“找死，我成全你！”
嗤啦！
然而，就在手中的长剑，剑气纵横，凝聚成为无数密密麻麻的剑影，仿佛一轮明亮的月亮，朝着林晨斩下来之时。
他突然瞪大眼睛，因为袭击到身前的林晨，不知道什么时候，已经出现在他的身前，手中的长剑，闪烁着森然的杀意和剑芒，朝着自己的胸膛刺过来。
“不……不可能……剑意大成？”
蒋深感受到林晨袭来的长剑，脸色彻底大变。
他本就是修炼剑法之人，如此近距离感受到林晨袭来的长剑，只感觉到浑身毛孔直立，手中的长剑不断颤抖。
content_en:
"Huh?"
Hearing Lin Chen's words, Jiang Shen held the long sword in his hand and was stunned for a moment, then a strange smile appeared on his face: "As long as you kneel down and beg for mercy now, of course I won't kill you."
He really didn't expect that the City Lord's Mansion would be so sick that he sought medical treatment and invited a third-level Nascent Soul Realm peak person to participate in the martial arts competition. It was simply humiliating himself.
"Hahaha! Where did this kid come from? He represents the city lord's palace to participate in the martial arts competition?"
"I think the City Lord's Mansion really has no choice but to choose someone at the third level of Nascent Soul Realm."
"Could he be so frightened by Jiang Shen that he knelt down on the spot?"
"In that case, the City Lord's Mansion will be really disgraced."
Many onlookers heard Lin Chen's words, their eyes widened, and their brows were filled with surprise. They couldn't understand the meaning of Lin Chen's question.
"Master Feng, is this boy really representing our city lord's palace in the martial arts competition?"
Several members of the City Lord's Mansion were also a little stunned and couldn't help but tilt their heads and look at Feng Dekun.
"I..."
Feng Dekun had been very uncomfortable with Lin Chen since last night, and now he saw Lin Chen standing on the martial arts square, and in full view of everyone, he actually asked such a low-level question.
If he hadn't thought that it was a martial arts competition, he would have really wanted to rush forward and ask Lin Chen to throw him down quickly so that he wouldn't be embarrassed standing in the martial arts square.
"Sir Ren, what is the origin of this boy?"
The few people who followed him out of the training room of the City Lord's Mansion just now were also surprised.
"Alas! It's hard to explain in words."
Ren Yi stared at Lin Chen's back, couldn't help but shake his head and sighed.
"I don't know why, but I always feel that this kid is not simple." When several people were discussing, the old man who came out of the training room first said: "If you think about it carefully, with the spiritual power of heaven and earth absorbed last night, even you and I can't do it even if we are at the peak of the high-level creation realm, right?"
"It seems..."
After hearing the words, several people also nodded slightly thoughtfully.
"It means that as long as you don't kneel down and beg for mercy, you can kill without mercy."
Lin Chen, who was originally calm, suddenly raised his head, a piercing chill suddenly burst out in his eyes, and the Blood Night Sword suddenly appeared in his hand.
A cold sword light burst out from the long sword, and the spiritual power in his body surged crazily.
The killing intent burst out from his whole body, and blood-red light surrounded the sword body. He took one step forward and slashed towards Jiang Shen with the long sword.
"Hahaha... you also want to... kill me..."
Jiang Shen never expected that he would stop in his tracks and not take action first. He did not expect that the opponent, who was only at the third level of Nascent Soul Realm, would dare to attack him.
In particular, the other party was also a swordsman. He was the number one swordsman genius in Juqiao City. Seeing Lin Chen's ordinary attack with the long sword, his face was filled with disdain.
"Earth-level low-grade swordsmanship: Shadow Moon Swordsmanship."
Jiang Shen held the long sword in his hand and watched Lin Chen attack. His cultivation at the seventh level of the Nascent Soul Realm exploded out of his body. He seemed unhurried. When he saw Lin Chen's long sword stabbing three or four meters in front of him, his spiritual power surged crazily. He raised the long sword and said with a cold face: "If you are looking for death, I will help you!"
Tsk!
However, the long sword in his hand, with sword energy flowing horizontally and vertically, condensed into countless dense sword shadows, like a bright moon, as it slashed down towards Lin Chen.
His eyes suddenly widened, because Lin Chen, who had attacked him, had appeared in front of him at some unknown moment. The long sword in his hand was flashing with murderous intent and sword light, and he was stabbing towards his chest.
"No...impossible...the sword will is perfected?"
Jiang Shen felt the long sword coming from Lin Chen, and his expression changed completely.
He was a practitioner of swordsmanship. When he felt Lin Chen's long sword at such a close distance, he felt that the pores all over his body stood upright and the long sword in his hand kept trembling.
